name: api-evangelist/thinknum
what_it_holds: API Evangelist's independent write-up of Thinknum's alternative-data platform surface: job listings, store locations, product pricing, web traffic, app reviews, social engagement metrics tracked across companies. Descriptive markdown only, no data or working client.
why_useful: Thinknum tracks exactly the kind of company-level web/app/job-posting metrics relevant to gaps 5 (engagement, app rankings) and 15 (job-posting trackers as headcount proxy for Airbnb) — worth knowing the product exists, but this repo has zero committed data and the real Thinknum product is paid/enterprise.
themes: Alternative-data vendor sample repos: vendors publishing free samples on GitHub (Advan, Similarweb, Apptopia, Yipit-like, Consumer Edge, Earnest, M Science, Quiver Quant, Thinknum)

name: api-evangelist/apptopia
what_it_holds: API Evangelist profile describing Apptopia's app-market-intelligence product: app download/revenue/usage/ratings/SDK-adoption estimates across iOS App Store, Google Play, Tencent, Xiaomi, Mobile 360 stores. Markdown description only, no data, no working client, no free tier documented.
why_useful: Apptopia-style app download/usage estimates for the Airbnb app would directly address gap 5 (engagement: app downloads/rankings history), but this repo is descriptive only — it confirms the product exists and roughly what it covers, nothing pullable.

name: chat-data-llc/shopify_store_traffic_api
what_it_holds: Script using an unofficial/reverse-engineered SimilarWeb endpoint to pull traffic estimates for Shopify stores specifically (no general-domain support out of the box), no data committed, 61 stars.
why_useful: Demonstrates a free/unofficial SimilarWeb scrape path (no paid key) but is scoped to Shopify storefronts, not applicable to airbnb.com without rewriting; flagged only as a proof that an unofficial-endpoint route exists.
